rendered: The paper that locks strain into a battery-electrode film by coating it on superelastic NiTi wires is "Tunable Mechanochemistry of Lithium Battery Electrodes" by Nitin Muralidharan et al. The authors applied axial tensile strains of 0%, 5%, and 10% to the wires, which caused an average compressive strain along the 'c' direction of the metal oxide film.
